name: drop-minus-words
description:
The phrase without its minus-words: «купить диван -бесплатно -скачать» → «купить диван». A lone «-» between words is a dash and stays («диван - кровать»). The words are joined by one space.

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

Example: semkit read core.csv drop-minus-words write out.csv

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
